title: Falling boulders making a massive landslide.
description: Approximately four thousand cubic meters of rock came loose from a cliff face above the site, and thankfully, no one was injured.
content: Approximately four thousand cubic meters of rock came loose from a cliff face above the site, and thankfully, no one was injured.
de: Herabfallende Felsbrocken lösten einen gewaltigen Erdrutsch aus. Ungefähr viertausend Kubikmeter Fels lösten sich von einer Felswand oberhalb des Geländes, und glücklicherweise wurde niemand verletzt.
en: Falling boulders making a massive landslide.. Approximately four thousand cubic meters of rock came loose from a cliff face above the site, and thankfully, no one was injured.
la: Saxa cadentes in terram magnam faciebant. Fere quattuor milia metrorum cubicorum saxorum e facie rupe supra situm solvebantur, et gratanter nemo laesus est.
